items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-09-18
items.q: Dan and I had many fist fights. We'd fight over a baseball bat... But it wasn't serious fights.

ctx.x: You might have had a few fist fights.

Oh, we had fist fights. Dan and I had many fist fights. We'd fight over a baseball bat, over a baseball glove or something like that. And Bonnie and I used to fight like two strange dogs. Today and tomorrow we'd be hugging and kissing each other. But it wasn't serious fights.

Well, your family, that's one thing I noticed yesterday. We were at the concert and families are very affectionate, you know. People, the Creole families, you know, they hug and kiss each other and they're always glad to see each other. And people always shaking hands and touching each other.
